generationBoundary: Every visible form in the compact-control inactive surface, active surface, pause, continue, speed, and close resources was produced by the built-in ImageGen interface. Deterministic processing preserves each action glyph's canvas and alpha bytes while normalizing visible RGB to neutral white, renders Primary/Danger SVG container fields from their explicit semantic colors, then performs the recorded significant-alpha crop, premultiplied resize, low-alpha cleanup, centered 128px nine-slice or 96px glyph placement, gallery composition, metadata, and hashes. It does not create or alter glyph geometry.

semanticContainerNormalization.deterministicTransform: Render the existing SVG geometry with its semantic Primary container fill; alpha, outline, canvas, and nine-slice geometry are unchanged.
Render the existing SVG geometry with its semantic Danger container fill; alpha, outline, canvas, and nine-slice geometry are unchanged.

assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: Sunny Orchard game UI pause glyph source, isolated transparent PNG. Primary request: a clearly visible PAUSE symbol made of exactly two parallel upright solid brown bars. Both bars must be fully opaque. Style/medium: minimal flat monochrome 2D icon. Composition/framing: centered, symmetric; bars occupy the middle 46% of canvas width and 56% height; bar width equals gap width; gently rounded bar ends. Color palette: opaque warm dark brown RGB(111,72,47), alpha 255 throughout the bar interiors. Transparency contract: RGBA; background alpha exactly 0; only the two bars alpha 255 plus antialiased edges. Constraints: exactly two visible bars. Avoid: empty output, black fill, circle, plate, badge, border, gradient, highlight, shadow, texture, decoration, text, checkerboard, watermark.

assets.prompt: Production game UI asset on native transparent RGBA: one complete ACTIVE compact-control surface. A single centered filled rounded square with a calm uniform flat cream interior RGB near (251,237,194), surrounded by exactly one flat mid-amber outer contour RGB near (201,132,59), #C9843B. Simple high-readability silhouette. Geometry: square canvas, front view, symmetric, outer rounded-square footprint about 94% of canvas, corner radius about 15%, contour thickness about 3.5% of canvas so it reads as 2-3px at 52x52. The cream fill directly meets the amber contour. Exactly one outer contour, no inner line. Genuine alpha transparency outside the rounded square. Strictly flat color: no highlight, no shadow, no gradient, no texture, no bevel, no glow, no dark brown edge, no second rim, no decoration, no icon, no text, no background, no checkerboard. Return only the native transparent PNG asset.
